svg.title: The memory layout of the design document's request: a page is a row of pieces, one in each of the ten buffers that the layers of a group share with the other groups
svg.desc: A grid with a row for each of the request's eleven pages and a column for each of ten buffers. The first seven rows are the full group's pages, the next two are the first sliding group's and the last two are the second sliding group's, each set apart by a gap and a dimension line. A page is one piece in each buffer, so one page id names ten pieces. A buffer holds one layer of each of the three groups.

text.font-family: 'Atkinson Hyperlegible', system-ui, 'Segoe UI', Arial, sans-serif

svg.text: each buffer holds one layer of every group
